full_prompt_en: A square fantasy painting shows a young winged woman seated sideways on a pale stone ledge against an almost empty ivory background. She has dark curly hair gathered loosely at the crown and a delicate profile turned left toward a small brown butterfly suspended before her face. One hand rests near her chin in thought; the other hangs softly toward a carved spiral at the lower left. Her cream dress has short puffed sleeves and a lightly pleated skirt, held by a dark brown fitted bodice. Brown lace-up boots cover her feet, while one bare knee and long forearm form elegant diagonal lines across the composition. Behind her, a large translucent tan wing opens upward and to the right. Its fine curved ribs are visible through the muted membrane. At the right side of the ledge, a pale catlike creature perches over a textured globe, watching outward. Several small animals gather along the bottom: a rounded sleeping one by her boot, a pale tiny one under the ledge, and two slender brown ones to the right. The exact species matter less than their gentle, curious forms. The stone base and background carry faint ornamental circles and delicate linework, barely stronger than the cream ground. Soft light from the upper left models skin, cloth folds, wing veins, and rounded animals without strong cast shadows. The palette is almost monochrome: ivory, parchment, taupe, warm skin, and restrained dark brown. Precise drawing and smooth tonal shading give the fanciful scene a quiet sculptural clarity. The wide unoccupied left area balances the grouped figure and animals on the right. The whole painting feels serene, slightly strange, and meticulously imagined.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形奇幻绘画描绘一位年轻带翅女子侧坐于浅色石台上，背后是几乎空白的象牙色背景。深色卷发在头顶松松挽起，精细侧脸朝左，注视面前悬停的一只小棕蝶。一只手若有所思地靠近下颌，另一只手柔软垂向左下雕刻螺旋。奶油色连衣裙有短蓬袖和轻褶裙摆，深棕色紧身上衣束住腰身。棕色系带靴包住脚，一处裸露膝盖和修长前臂在画面中形成优雅斜线。身后，一片巨大的半透明褐色翅膀向右上展开，细弯骨架透过低调翼膜可见。石台右侧，一只浅色似猫小兽停在有纹理的球体上，向外张望。几只小动物聚在下方：靴旁一只圆润熟睡的，石台下方一只浅色小兽，右侧还有两只修长棕色的。确切物种不如温柔、好奇的形体重要。石座与背景有淡淡装饰圆和精细线痕，仅比奶油色底面略强。柔光从左上方照来，为皮肤、衣褶、翼脉和圆润动物塑形，却没有强烈投影。色域近乎单色：象牙、羊皮纸、灰褐、暖肤色和克制深棕。精确素描与平滑明暗赋予奇妙场景安静雕塑般的清晰度。左侧大片空处平衡右侧聚拢的人物和动物。整幅画安详、略奇异而构思细致。
style_prompt_en: A refined fantasy painting works within ivory, parchment, taupe, and restrained warm brown. Precise contour drawing and smooth, pale shading describe softly rounded forms, while fine ribbed lines add delicacy to broad translucent planes. A few darker accents locate the focal group against a generous empty field. Curves, spirals, and long diagonals give the composition a graceful, decorative flow. Upper-side light shapes surfaces gently, without dramatic shadows or hard contrast. The ground is almost blank, carrying only faint ornamental geometry and linework. Textures are selectively tactile in folds, veins, stone-like edges, and fur-like areas, while the overall finish remains clean and quiet. The result is elegant, dreamlike, and carefully balanced.
style_prompt_zh: 精致奇幻绘画限于象牙色、羊皮纸色、灰褐与克制暖棕。精确轮廓线和平滑浅色阴影描绘柔和圆润的形体，细密肋状线条赋予宽阔半透明平面精微感。少数深色重音在大片留白前标定焦点群。曲线、螺旋和长斜线使构图优雅而富装饰流动。偏上侧的光轻柔塑造表面，没有戏剧性阴影或坚硬对比。底面几乎空白，只保留淡淡装饰几何和线痕。褶皱、脉络、似石边缘及似毛区域的纹理有选择地可触，整体完成度仍干净安静。结果优雅、如梦且平衡谨慎。
theme_en: A seated winged woman watches a butterfly among small animals on a pale stone ledge
theme_zh: 一位带翅膀的女子坐在浅色石台上，凝视蝴蝶，身边聚着小动物
name: Michael Parkes
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
